name: Peruvian
description: Peruvian home cooking spans the coast, Andes and Amazon, using potatoes, corn, quinoa, beans, vegetables and many different proteins. These are traditional dishes and sides, not a prescribed diet.
tip: Build a varied plate with a bean or vegetable side. Some traditional dishes are rich or low in fiber; use the full source recipe and choose portions that fit your needs.

name: Brazilian
description: Brazilian home cooking varies greatly by region. Beans and rice, leafy greens, cassava, corn and fish stews appear alongside meat dishes and regional specialties.
tip: Include beans and vegetables alongside a main. Traditional dishes differ in salt, fat and fiber; the ingredient lists here are summaries rather than measured nutrition claims.
